title: FNAF 1 Door Sound
blurb: Metal on metal, heavy and final, and every press of it eats power you do not have. The office doors in the first Five Nights at Freddy's are the whole game in one mechanic: safety costs electricity, electricity runs out, and the doors decide whether the night stays quiet or ends with Bonnie in your doorway. Players learned to slam and release in tiny bursts. The sound now works across horror edits as shorthand for shutting something out and praying the battery holds.
origin: The office door sound from Five Nights at Freddy's (2014).
